Local animation libraries used for the requested Jetton motion behavior.

GSAP 3.13.0 and ScrollTrigger 3.13.0
Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.13.0/dist/
Documentation and license: https://gsap.com/standard-license/
Original copyright and license notices are retained in each distribution file.

Lenis 1.3.18
Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lenis@1.3.18/dist/
MIT license: https://github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis/blob/main/LICENSE

These are the same library versions observed on the supplied Jetton reference.
Site-specific animation timelines are implemented in motion.js.
